root_cause.text: The function `tps53679_identify_chip()` fails to handle a zero-length block read (`ret == 0`) from `i2c_smbus_read_block_data()`, causing an out-of-bounds access when indexing `buf[ret - 1]` (i.e., `buf[-1]`).
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the error check from `if (ret < 0)` to `if (ret <= 0)` and returns `-EIO` for `ret == 0`. The commit message explicitly states: "When this happens, tps53679_identify_chip() accesses buf[ret - 1] which is buf[-1], reading one byte before the buffer on the stack."
